title: Screen flows: the paused screen does not say whether it is the last one, so a wizard button reads 「提交」 on every step and no step counter can be drawn
body:
Carries items 1 and 3 of #26578: the step button label and the step counter. #26578 keeps item 2, the between-steps toast, which PR #26656 delivers.

Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect with a named location and a measured cause. Split by seat `domain:ui#4` (`session_01QsR2jTfvjNTaR29ehLk26T`) from the #26578 os-dev report (comment 6440951100), because the remaining half needs a contract addition outside the ui lane.

**Business reason.** A multi-step screen flow is how an app builds a wizard. In hotclm's 发起合同 wizard, every step's primary button reads 「提交」, so a requester believes the contract was submitted on step 1. The last step's real choice (立即提交) then reads as noise. The user is also never told how many steps remain.

**Measured cause** (origin/main, 2026-10-27, read by the #26578 thread):
- The paused screen the engine sends is `ScreenSpec` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`. It carries `nodeId`, `title`, `description`, `fields`, `kind`, `objectName`, `mode`, `recordId`, `defaults` and `idVariable`. It has no final-step or remaining-steps member.
- The engine's screen executor, `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-nodes.ts`, emits exactly those keys.
- A flow can branch after any screen, so only the engine can answer "is another screen reachable from here", from the graph. The client learns it only after the fact, when a resume answers `paused` again.

**Wanted.** The engine tells the runner, on each paused screen, whether another screen node is reachable downstream (and, where the graph allows, how many). `FlowRunner` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx`) then reads 「下一步」 on a step that is not the last, 「提交」 on the last, and draws a step counter only when the total is known.

Seam: `spec:ScreenSpec (packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts) → runtime:screen-nodes.ts screen executor → renderer:FlowRunner flat-screen footer`

**Readers who act:** triage routes the contract and engine half (a `packages/spec` wire addition plus the `service-automation` emitter). The `ui/` consumer half follows in the same PR as its first reader, or as a ui child card.

**Duplicate search:** objectstack issues, all states, semantic search "screen flow wizard last screen next button step count ScreenSpec" → 2 hits: #26578 (the parent) and #25801 (closed; flat screens and file fields, a different gap). Control: #26578 is found by the same query. No duplicate.
